races.title: State Senate, District 8
races.note: The top two finishers from the Nov 3, 2026 count. Everyone else in this race is coming.

cands.name: Bill Rabon
cands.bio: Republican state senator for North Carolina Senate District 8 since January 2011. A veterinarian with a degree from the University of Georgia (1976) and a partner in multiple animal hospitals. Chairs the Senate Rules and Operations committee and has chaired the Finance committee.
cands.gaps: We found no documented statements or actions by Rabon on data centers, homestead property tax relief, limits on out-of-state or institutional land buyers, growth and land conservation, police pay, gun laws, abortion, or school vouchers and charters. The only stated positions we found come from his 2010 campaign website as quoted by Ballotpedia, and nothing more recent. His birthplace, where he grew up, and when he came to North Carolina were not found. Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for him in 2024 or 2026, and he did not complete its candidate surveys. We found no controversies. The Wikipedia page is a short stub with no sources or detail.

qual.background: State senator since 2011 (about 15 years). He has chaired Senate Finance, Rules and Operations, and Pensions and Retirement, and has served on Appropriations and Base Budget. He is a veterinarian and a partner in multiple animal hospitals.
qual.why: Long prior legislative service on the state's tax and budget committees, plus small-business ownership as a practice partner. Committee chairmanships were not counted toward the score.
qual.label: Long prior legislative service on the state's tax and budget committees, plus small-business ownership as a practice partner. Committee chairmanships were not counted toward the score.

workers-first.evidence: In his 2010 campaign, Rabon's website said North Carolina had been too lenient on illegal immigration and that he would fight to stop it.

school-choice-teachers.evidence: In his 2010 campaign, Rabon's website said he would fight to pay teachers a competitive salary so the state attracts and retains the best educators.

cands.name: Richard (Rick) Combes
cands.bio: Retired chemical engineer and businessman with a University of Michigan engineering degree and a University of Chicago MBA. Worked at Kraft Foods, holds a patent, and led construction of a resin plant in High Point. Later drove for Uber in the Wilmington area. Democratic candidate for NC Senate District 8 in 2026; has held no elected office.

endorsements.text: Listed on Ballotpedia as receiving voter-guide recommendations from three Sway voting groups: 'Reject AIPAC from City Council to Congress' (Vote for Peace), 'Unburdening The Ballot: Voting Made Easy' (Tevin Davis), and 'Waves of Democracy' (Terri Robinson).

cands.gaps: We could not find where Combes was born or raised, or when he moved to North Carolina. His site says he has been a Carolinian all his life but that it took him 55 years to realize it, which does not settle the question. He has held no public office, so there is no voting or legislative record. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey. His site has headings on PFAS and water contamination, ethics and anti-corruption, the Cape Fear Memorial Bridge, public schools, and impact fees for growth. The full text of those pages was not available, so we cannot report his specific positions on them. We found no documented statements from him on data centers, homestead property taxes, foreign or investor land buying, immigration or H-1B, policing, guns or abortion. We also found no controversies, foreign ties or notable endorsements beyond the voter-guide listings.
